entries.title: An Elastic approach to large-scale dynamic malware analysis
entries.description: This research reveals insights into some of the large-scale malware analysis performed by Elastic Security Labs, and complements research related to the Detonate framework.

entries.title: The DPRK strikes using a new variant of RUSTBUCKET
entries.description: Watch out! We’ve recently discovered a variant of RUSTBUCKET. Read this article to understand the new capabilities we’ve observed, as well as how to identify it in your own network.
